about_the_game:
Game Introduction：

Coin Push RPG is a casual idle game incorporating coin-pusher mechanics, featuring abundant content and multiple gameplay modes. The game includes:

1:1 Replicated Coin-Pusher Simulator Mode - Faithfully recreates the arcade coin-pusher experience

Adventure Mode - Complete with extensive character backgrounds, talent combinations, and equipment selection

Challenge Mode - Combines fast-paced monster battles with idle mechanisms for effortless farming

Players will recruit heroes, customize their unique talent skills, assemble various team formations, and lead them on treasure-hunting expeditions. Upgrade your village, craft legendary equipment, and enhance your strength to conquer the Demon King!

Coin Push Mode – 1:1 Replica

In the game, players can experience an authentic 1:1 replica of a real coin pusher arcade machine, featuring:

  • Rotating Wheel (Lucky Spin)

  • Tower Stacker (Tower Bonus)

  • JP123 Jackpot

  • Full-Table Grand Prize


Idle Coin Pushing – Relaxing Auto-Battler

During battles, the coins collected from the Coin Pusher will be distributed to your heroes. They’ll only fight for you once they get their fair share!

Pay up to make your heroes work for you—or just sit back, auto-drop coins, and let them grind for you effortlessly! 

Hero Recruitment & Character Development

Every hero comes with unique backstories and rarity tiers. Recruit and train a diverse team of warriors, refine their stats, and equip them with powerful gear and talents to build the ultimate squad!

Talent System - Massive Customization

With 260+ unique buff talents to mix and match, you can:

  • Enhance your heroes' strengths in different ways

  • Boost coin pusher rewards through strategic synergies

  • Create explosive combat combos for maximum farming efficiency

Build your perfect setup and dominate the battlefield!

Gear Progression & Stat Refinement

As you explore, monsters will drop 100+ powerful equipment pieces - including rare artifacts with exclusive special attributes.

Progress through the game to:

  • Refine your gear's stats

  • Enhance their power

  • Rebuild them from scratch

Forge your ultimate endgame equipment through continuous optimization!

Tactical Formation & Positioning

Customize your battle lineup and strategically position heroes to maximize their combat effectiveness!

  • Freely assemble your dream team

  • Optimize positioning to enhance skill synergy

  • Adapt formations for different challenges

Place your warriors where they shine brightest and dominate the battlefield

short_description: Coin Push RPG is a unique blend of Semi-Idle RPG and coin-pusher gameplay! Recruit legendary heroes, equip them with powerful gear, upgrade your town, construct buildings, and unlock stunning backgrounds as you expand your influence. Build a diverse and unstoppable team with your own unique style .
